wcagOutcomes.title: Keyboard
wcagOutcomes.outcome: All combobox functionality is operable via keyboard alone. No mouse required to open, navigate, select, or close.

wcagOutcomes.title: No Keyboard Trap
wcagOutcomes.outcome: Focus is never trapped inside the popup. Escape always closes the popup and returns focus to the trigger.

wcagOutcomes.title: Info and Relationships
wcagOutcomes.outcome: The combobox role, popup association, selected state, and option semantics are all programmatically determinable.

wcagOutcomes.title: Name, Role, Value
wcagOutcomes.outcome: The trigger exposes combobox role plus accessible name. The popup exposes listbox role. Each option exposes option role plus aria-selected state.

ariaPattern.triggerSemantics: Element with role=combobox. Must carry aria-haspopup=listbox, aria-expanded, and aria-controls pointing to the popup.
ariaPattern.popupAssociation: aria-controls on trigger references the id of the listbox element.
ariaPattern.listboxSemantics: Popup element carries role=listbox and aria-labelledby referencing the trigger or a visible label.
ariaPattern.optionSemantics: Each selectable item carries role=option and aria-selected=true|false.
ariaPattern.expandedState: aria-expanded=true when popup is visible; aria-expanded=false when collapsed.
ariaPattern.selectedState: aria-selected=true on the currently selected option; aria-selected=false on all others.

keyboardModel.ArrowDown: If closed, open popup and move focus to first option. If open, move focus to next option.
keyboardModel.ArrowUp: If closed, open popup and move focus to last option. If open, move focus to previous option.
keyboardModel.Enter: Accept focused option, close popup, return focus to trigger.
keyboardModel.Escape: Close popup without changing selection, return focus to trigger.
keyboardModel.Home: Move focus to first option in open popup.
keyboardModel.End: Move focus to last option in open popup.
keyboardModel.Tab: Close popup if open, move focus to next focusable element in page.

ariaValidity.description: role=combobox is allowed on <button>, <div>, or <span>. Must NOT be placed on <input> for a select-only pattern.
Trigger must carry aria-haspopup=listbox, aria-expanded (true|false), and aria-controls referencing the popup id.
The popup referenced by aria-controls must expose role=listbox. No other popup role is valid for this pattern.
aria-selected must be explicitly set to true or false on every option. Omitting aria-selected is invalid.
Options must not carry aria-checked, aria-pressed, or aria-expanded. These are not valid on role=option.
Individual options must receive DOM focus during keyboard navigation. The listbox element itself must not be the sole focus target.

accessibleName.description: Preferred. A visible label element with a matching id is referenced by aria-labelledby on the trigger.
Acceptable when no visible label exists. Provide a concise descriptive string.
A <label> element associated via htmlFor / for attribute pointing to the trigger id.
Placeholder text or current selected value must not be the sole accessible name source. The name must persist regardless of selection state.

automation.description: Query getByRole('combobox', { name }) to confirm trigger has a non-empty accessible name.
Query getByRole('combobox') to confirm the trigger exposes combobox semantics.
Assert aria-expanded=false before interaction. Click or press ArrowDown. Assert aria-expanded=true. Press Escape. Assert aria-expanded=false.
Assert aria-controls on trigger. Assert the referenced element exists in the DOM and carries role=listbox.
After opening, query getByRole('listbox') to confirm popup exposes listbox semantics.
After opening, query getAllByRole('option') to confirm selectable items expose option semantics.
Assert aria-selected=true on the selected option and aria-selected=false on all others after a selection.
Focus trigger. Press ArrowDown. Assert popup visible and first option receives focus.
Open popup. Navigate to a non-default option. Press Enter. Assert popup closed, trigger reflects new selection, and focus is on trigger.
Open popup. Press Escape. Assert popup hidden, selection unchanged, and focus returned to trigger.
Run axe-core scoped to the component root in both collapsed and expanded states.

manualReview.description: Automated tests confirm ARIA attributes are present; they cannot verify that NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver actually announce the combobox, options, and state changes in a usable way. Requires manual testing with at least one screen reader.

Automated tests confirm focus moves to the correct element; they cannot verify that the visible focus indicator meets WCAG 2.4.11 or is perceptible to low-vision users. Requires manual visual inspection.
Automated tests cannot determine whether a native <select> element would better serve users in this product context. A human must evaluate whether the custom component is justified.
Playwright tests run in a single browser/AT pairing. Cross-browser screen reader behavior (e.g. Chrome+NVDA vs Safari+VoiceOver) must be verified manually.
Automated tests confirm option text is non-empty; they cannot verify that option labels are meaningful, unambiguous, or appropriate in the product context.
The number of options, grouping strategy, and interaction model may impose cognitive load. This requires human judgment and cannot be automated.

specfirstPolicy.description: If a native <select> element can satisfy the product requirements, it must be recommended over the custom combobox. Bob must not patch a custom combobox into existence where a native element would suffice.

Bob may only add or correct ARIA attributes and keyboard event handlers defined in this manifest. Bob must not restructure the DOM, change element types, add new interactive controls, or introduce ARIA roles not listed in ariaValidity.
Bob must not move ARIA attributes to a host element not listed in ariaValidity.combobox-host-element. If the host element is invalid, Bob must flag for human review, not patch silently.
If the popup contains checkboxes, links, action buttons, or freeform text input, Phase 3 must stop. This manifest does not cover mixed-interactive popups.
If the component supports multiple simultaneous selections, this manifest must not be applied. A separate manifest covering aria-multiselectable is required.

requires: single selected value at a time
static option collection (options do not change at runtime)
trigger-controlled popup (popup opens only on trigger interaction)
mapped selectable options (each option maps to a discrete value)
no freeform text input inside the popup
rejectIf: action button present inside option subtree

requirements.description: The combobox trigger exposes a non-empty accessible name that persists regardless of the current selection state.
The primary trigger element exposes role=combobox.
The combobox trigger exposes whether its popup is expanded or collapsed via aria-expanded.
The trigger is programmatically associated with the popup via aria-controls.
Each selectable item inside the popup exposes role=option.
The selected option exposes aria-selected=true; all other options expose aria-selected=false.
ArrowDown on the trigger opens the popup and moves focus to the first option.
Enter on a focused option accepts that option, closes the popup, and returns focus to the trigger.
Escape closes the popup without changing the current selection and returns focus to the trigger.
axe-core scoped to the component root returns zero violations in both collapsed and expanded states.

bobPatchConstraints: May only add or correct ARIA attributes defined in ariaValidity
May only add keyboard event handlers defined in ariaPattern.keyboardModel
Must not restructure the DOM or change element types
Must not introduce ARIA roles not listed in ariaValidity
Must flag invalid host elements for human review instead of patching silently
Must not create a custom combobox where a native <select> would suffice

allowedLanguage: Automated checks passed for the requirements defined in this manifest
Manual review is required before making accessibility claims
This manifest covers the select-only combobox pattern only
reportBoundary.rationale: Automated tests verify ARIA structure and keyboard mechanics. They cannot verify screen reader announcement quality, visual focus quality, or cross-browser assistive technology behavior. No compliance claim may be made on the basis of this manifest alone.
